components.title: Do you live with other people?

components.name: SUlWLU
components.title: Why are we asking for this information?
components.content: We ask this to identify people you live with and may have passed bird (avian) flu on to. This is so we can provide the right guidance to them or someone on their behalf, such as how to get tested and other health advice.
